image_description: A low-resolution indoor photograph of a church sanctuary featuring a white altar table covered with a white cloth. Two people stand behind the altar: a man in a dark suit on the left and a woman in a vestment on the right. A wooden cross is mounted on the wall behind the altar. In the foreground, there is a smaller table or stand also draped in white cloth with a floral arrangement on top. Stained glass windows are visible in the background.

artifact_observations.location: Global image, specifically facial features and floral arrangement
artifact_observations.reasoning: The image suffers from significant low-resolution compression artifacts and general softness. Facial features of the humans are indistinct and 'mushy'. The floral arrangement lacks distinct petal definition, appearing as a smeared color blob. This is characteristic of low-quality generation or heavy compression.

The folds in the white cloth lack crisp shadow definition and appear slightly plastic or smudged rather than exhibiting realistic fabric texture. The edges where the cloth meets the floor are soft and ill-defined.
The connection between the flowers and the vase/container on the foreground table is unclear. The stems seem to merge into the container without clear structural logic, appearing as a fused mass.
